periods.description: Academy in Crossfield where Lux, Airi and the heroines study or teach. It remains a central community even after the final battle and graduation ceremony.
periods.history: The main school setting that connected Lux with his companions during the series.
periods.goals: Train Drag-Ride pilots and officers for the New Kingdom and allied order.
periods.structure: Students, instructors, special lecturers, dormitory staff and infirmary staff.
